Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick intro. We're ready to set Redwood up as a supplier in StellarPay so we can issue POs and route invoices to AP. To complete vendor activation we need the following from Redwood:

- Completed StellarPay vendor activation form (attached).
- Tax evidence (W-9 for US entities or VAT registration certificate for EU entities).
- Bank remit instructions (bank name, account number, SWIFT/IBAN, ACH routing).
- Company legal name and address to match invoices/1099s.
- Point of contact for invoice disputes (name/email/phone).

Notes / PO policy:
- All invoices must reference a StellarPay PO number to be paid.
- Payment terms: net 30 after PO acceptance unless otherwise negotiated.
- Invoices can be submitted to accounts@stellarpay.com or via our vendor portal (preferred).

I've attached the vendor activation form for your team to complete and a short checklist. Once we confirm the supplier record we will issue a test PO and provide a supplier code.

Attachment: StellarPay_Vendor_Activation_Form.pdf (PDF, 132KB)

Can you send the W-9 and bank remit? Also, do you have a preferred remit-to address for the PO?

Thanks,
